import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    s = np.sin(0.4*t); c = np.cos(0.4*t)
    h = p[0] + p[1]*t + p[2]*t*t + (p[3] + p[4]*t)*s + (p[5] + p[6]*t)*c
    return p[7]*t + p[8]*P*np.log(P) + h/P + p[9]*P
